spans.s: aruhaṇa (EI 27), probably, the tax also called āruvaṇa.
āruvaṇa (EI 27), same as Tamil ar̤uvaṇa (IA 19), the tax of six paṇas levied on mānya lands.
ār̤r̤u-kkulai (SITI), Tamil; ‘river-bund’; tax to repair breaches in the river-bund.
ār̤r̤ukkāl-amañji (SITI), Tamil; unpaid labour to keep the channel from the river in good repair.
aruntoḍu (SITI), Tamil; ‘eating-plate’; a tax payable according to the number of eating plates in feeding houses.
